What is the ratio of the production of rice in Bihar in 2016 to the production of rice in UP in 2017?
solution:
**Given:**

Production of rice in Bihar in 2016 = 250 hundred tonnes

Production of rice in UP in 2017 = 225 hundred tonnes

**Formula used:**

Ratio = Production in Bihar (2016) / Production in UP (2017)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio = 250 / 225

⇒ Ratio = 50 / 45

⇒ Ratio = 10 / 9

**∴ The required ratio is 10:9.**
